## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive — broad but not unanimous. Cyclical ETFs showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +6.50%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.43% | 1M: +14.22%)) while risk ratios remain flat (VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.61% | 1M: -8.13%) ↑ rising; HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.06%) → flat), supporting a neutral stance.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Commodity reflation and precious metals leadership: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.17% | 1M: +50.73%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +7.71%) ↑ rising are material drivers. Credit and rates are steady with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.06%) → flat and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.62% | 1M: +1.53%) → flat, keeping market direction ambiguous.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral — bonds and credit both modestly positive: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.62% | 1M: +1.53%) → flat; HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.06%) → flat. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.56%) → flat, so conditions are accommodative but not accelerating.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and materials leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +6.50%) and XME / XAR ABOVE TREND (XME 1W: +7.70% | 1M: +20.53%; XAR 1W: +8.80% | 1M: +20.77%). Tech is lagging: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.86%) and QQQ in CORRECTION (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +1.10%), so style is tilted toward cyclicals and commodities.

5. US vs Global?
US (SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.56%)) is steady while EM is showing strength: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +7.99%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +3.57%) ↑ rising. Nasdaq exposure mixed with QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +1.10%), so global risk appetite is shared but US leadership is not concentrated in tech.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows are present: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +8.28%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +3.50%) ↑ rising. Small caps IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.03%) confirm risk-on elements, though VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.61% | 1M: -8.13%) ↑ rising argues for short-term caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals and industrials leading: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.17% | 1M: +50.73%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.43% | 1M: +14.22%) ↑ rising, signaling reflation. Broad commodity ETFs DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.94% | 1M: +13.70%) support the theme.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing durable strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +6.50%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +6.41%) ↑ rising. Natural gas is the outlier: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -19.56%) ↓ falling.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: broad cyclicals and commodities (XLE ABOVE TREND, CPER ABOVE TREND) and equities breadth 7/11 positive. Major divergence in Tech: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.86%), QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +1.10%) and related ETFs showing 1W weakness vs 1M gains — a meaningful tech-group divergence that tempers conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposures while reducing exposure to lagging tech names; XLE and SLV showing strength, XLK and QQQ showing weakness. Bonds remain a neutral hedge with TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.62% | 1M: +1.53%) → flat; monitor VXX for short-term volatility pickup.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +6.50%), XME / XAR ABOVE TREND (XME 1W: +7.70% | 1M: +20.53%). BEARISH: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.86%), QQQ in CORRECTION (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +1.10%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.17% | 1M: +50.73%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.43% | 1M: +14.22%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -19.56%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.61% | 1M: -8.13%) ↑ rising — watch the 20 level for volatility regime changes. HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.06%) → flat vs LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +1.18%) → flat — monitor HYG/LQD for credit tone. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.86%) — watch relative tech leadership vs XLE.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive supporting cyclical and commodity leadership but not a decisive risk-on impulse. XLE, SLV and CPER showing strength while XLK and QQQ are the main divergence to monitor.
